title: Headless resume adapter
goal: The F-012 engine resumes a named session once without the editor
acceptance: Identity rechecked; once only; needs-attention on change
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A change of gate class, data leaving the base, or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner jobs case study, before design. Not a measurement.
